item.title: Netflix Renews THE LINCOLN LAWYER for Fifth Season Ahead of Its Season Four Premiere Next Week
item.description: Netflix’s legal drama The Lincoln Lawyer has been renewed for a fifth season ahead of its season 4 premiere at the streamer next week on February 5th.
